images.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create a landscape 16:9 startup splash background for a mechanical CAD design application. Show an attractive recognizable engineered 3D CAD model that a user could design, not an abstract sculpture, not a logo. Premium industrial design visualization with clearly modeled chamfers, fillets, bolt holes, component seams and believable materials. Dark charcoal studio background, restrained cool rim lighting, softly lit satin metal and matte components, three-quarter isometric perspective. No text, no labels, no branding, no UI, no progress bar, no dimension lines, no watermark. A polished portfolio render of a functional mechanical assembly; jaws clearly face each other with a gripping gap, parts connected plausibly, few tasteful blue anodized details.
